name: Boon Companions’ Bands

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: when one wearer creates an area effect requiring saves, protect the paired wearer in that area: automatic save success and no damage if success normally halves it.
text: Reference-only: when one wearer creates an area effect requiring saves, protect the paired wearer in that area: automatic save success and no damage if success normally halves it. Shared once-per-dawn use. Destroying either band destroys both.
